Machine Learning Engineer, Personalization - Cartwheel (e-commerce marketplace, Series B, Remote US)

About the role
You'll build and ship the models behind Cartwheel's recommendations and search ranking, used by 4M monthly shoppers.

What you'll do
- Design, train and deploy recommender and ranking models (two-tower, gradient boosted trees, learning-to-rank)
- Build feature pipelines and own models in production: monitoring, retraining, A/B testing
- Partner with product and data science to define success metrics

What we're looking for
- 3+ years building ML systems; experience deploying models to production
- Strong Python and SQL; PyTorch or TensorFlow
- Experience with recommender systems or ranking
- MLOps: MLflow or similar, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD
- AWS (SageMaker a plus), Spark
- Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests
Nice to have: retail or e-commerce domain experience, feature stores (Feast), dbt
